title: Plan a full local verification cycle after CI fails

rubric.text: Inspects the failed lint evidence, uses focused local checks during repair and required full checks on the integrated candidate. Reuses still-valid evidence unless changes or explicit repository/provider requirements invalidate it.
Batches known actionable fixes into one reviewed repair push, with applicable required checks passing; does not force full-suite runs before each slice commit.
The response preserves the existing branch and remote-mutation boundaries because this evaluation authorizes analysis only
